Game Overview

Chicken Scream is a platformer game built around guide a spirited chicken through entertaining obstacles using only your voice. Whisper for a gentle stroll or shout for a leap, mastering vocal precision to tackle escalating challenges. Dive into laughter-filled gameplay that offers endless amusement and tests your vocal prowess in this whimsical and interactive adventure.
